name: Tile Rings
description: The picture is cut into tiles that ride concentric rectangular rings like the dials of a combination lock: the rings turn a quarter of the way round in alternating directions, the tiles turning the corners like links of a chain, then the tiles flip over to the second clip in a ripple running round each ring, and the rings turn back until every tile clicks home. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rings
params.description: Number of rings, from the border to the center

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between the innermost ring and the outermost one, as a part of the transition

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows cast by the lifted tiles

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color of the tray seen between the tiles
